status: Prespecified before any evaluation on the generated suite

sampling_distribution.k: classes per biased block, uniform on {1,2,3,5}
sampling_distribution.mode: for n>1, uniform on {repeat, change, alternate}; n=1 is 'single'. repeat: same k digits every block; change: block i uses the next k digits of a cyclic walk through the episode's digit permutation; alternate: two disjoint k-digit sets alternate. For k=5, change and alternate give identical streams.
sampling_distribution.R: shuffled recovery after the last block: 0 with probability 0.2, else uniform on {1..100}
sampling_distribution.L: block length (batches): uniform on {max(2, ceil(Lmax/2))..Lmax}, Lmax the largest length that keeps every digit within its 1,280 draws and the blocks (with the minimum gap) inside the 200 - R batches
sampling_distribution.G: gap of mixed batches between consecutive blocks: 0 for n=1; repeat: uniform on {1..Gmax}; change/alternate: 0 with probability 0.5, else uniform on {1..Gmax}; Gmax=floor((200-R-nL)/(n-1))

stream_invariants: Same as run.stream: seeded balanced bag of 1,280 draws per digit (12,800 examples), digits permuted per episode, block labels spread over each block with np.resize, remaining bag shuffled into non-block positions, within-batch shuffle, 200 batches of 64. Same episode seed => same multiset, classifier initialization and probe set for every method.
episode_seeds: 5 per ordering, distinct across orderings: 1986000 + 5*i + j for ordering i, j=0..4 (1986000-1986999)
seed_disjointness: Checked against every earlier dev/test/training seed pool (check_design)

severity.primary: mean_kl: mean over the 200 batches of KL(expected batch class frequencies || uniform), from the spec; block batches have k equal classes, non-block batches the expected composition of the remaining bag (depleted of block digits)

nearness.distance: mean over batches of total-variation distance between expected class-frequency profiles (in permutation-slot space) to each of the seven original specs; nearest original reported
nearness.near_duplicate: same k, n and mode as an original, and L, start and R each within 10 batches; results reported with and without near-duplicates
nearness.near_duplicate_loose: secondary exclusion: profile distance <= 0.15 to any original

methods.fixed_regular: Fixed configuration tuned on regular development data (results/optimizer_families)
methods.fixed_extreme: Fixed configuration retuned on extreme development data (results/extreme_retrained)
methods.cosine_regular: Cosine LR schedule tuned on regular development data (results/prospective_schedules)
methods.warm_extreme: Extreme warm-start policies (results/extreme_warm_start), warm from the extreme-retuned fixed config

sibling_methods: Extreme-retuned cosine and random baselines from the PR 'Add extreme-ordering schedule and random baselines', evaluated with their own development-selected configurations once merged.
evaluation: Official MNIST test set (10,000 images) for final accuracy; one torch thread; one rollout per ordering with its five episode seeds; SGD fixed configurations via torch.optim.SGD (b.baseline) as in every saved SGD fixed row; failed episodes retained at their recorded accuracy.

analysis.unit: ordering (resampling unit), then episode seed, then policy seed
analysis.mean_accuracy: mean over orderings of the per-ordering mean over episode seeds (and policy seeds); policy-seed SD and range of per-seed means; failures counted
paired_differences: once available: cosine_extreme - fixed_extreme; cosine_{regular,extreme} - random; warm_extreme and policy_retrained - {cosine_extreme, random}
analysis.policy_pairing: policy - policy differences are seed-matched (same seed number); policy - unseeded comparator broadcasts the comparator
analysis.bootstrap: two-level (plus policy seeds): each of 10,000 resamples (numpy default_rng(238)) draws orderings with replacement, then the 5 episode seeds within each drawn ordering with replacement, then (seeded methods) the 5 policy seeds with replacement; 95% percentile CI
analysis.wins: fraction of orderings whose mean difference (over episode and policy seeds) is > 0; ties reported; policy seeds with positive overall mean difference out of 5
analysis.severity: per-ordering difference vs mean_kl: quintile bins (mean and bootstrap CI per bin, plot) and OLS slope with the ordering-level bootstrap CI; also vs biased_batches
analysis.subsets: all 200 orderings (primary); excluding near-duplicates of the seven originals; excluding the loose near set (profile distance <= 0.15)
analysis.replication: compare signs and magnitudes with the seven-ordering biased means in results/extreme_warm_start and results/prospective_schedules; state disagreements
